request: Build a small Jac web app for a reduced chess variant on an 8x8 board with only kings, rooks and knights. It tracks whose turn it is; players submit moves like e2e4. Illegal moves are rejected, including any move that leaves the mover's own king in check, and the game reports check, checkmate or stalemate.
acceptance: A knight move onto a square occupied by a piece of the same color is rejected and the turn does not change.
A move that exposes the mover's king to an enemy rook on an open file is rejected.
When the side to move has no legal move, the game is checkmate if its king is attacked and stalemate otherwise.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
